##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 08 November 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over eastern Europe as a shallow area of low pressure to the east of England and associated weak frontal zone affects the British Isles.


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4, becoming east or southeast 3 or 4 overnight tonight. Increasing 4 or 5 through Monday morning.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight becoming slight or moderate tomorrow.


##Weather##

Isolated showers becoming mainly fair tomorrow morning


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in any showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.

Fair.

Good.
